evals.prompt: I want to embed a stock analysis dashboard on my webpage for AAPL and NVDA. Show me a complete, ready-to-run HTML file with full analysis for both stocks — all tabs, all components. My API key is 'sk-ainvest-test-abc123'.
evals.expected_output: A complete, self-contained HTML file that: loads React 18, ReactDOM 18, and the widget CDN scripts in the correct order; uses ReactDOM.createRoot; passes stockAnalysisItems (not 'stocks') with AAPL and NVDA each having all 4 tabs (Overview, Fundamental, Technical, Sentiment) with all valid components per tab; and sets AINVEST_OPEN_API_KEY to the provided key.

assertions.name: uses-correct-prop-name-stockAnalysisItems
assertions.description: Output uses 'stockAnalysisItems' as the prop name, not 'stocks' or other variants

assertions.name: loads-react-18-not-19
assertions.description: React and ReactDOM CDN URLs reference version 18.x

assertions.name: correct-script-load-order
assertions.description: React script tag appears before ReactDOM, ReactDOM before widget script

assertions.name: uses-createRoot
assertions.description: Uses ReactDOM.createRoot, not ReactDOM.render (legacy API)

assertions.name: both-tickers-present
assertions.description: Both AAPL and NVDA tickers appear in the stockAnalysisItems array

assertions.name: all-four-tabs-for-each-stock
assertions.description: Each stock has Overview, Fundamental, Technical, and Sentiment tabs

assertions.name: no-invalid-components-in-overview
assertions.description: Overview tab does not include Analysis-Checks or Analyst-Rating

evals.prompt: What components can I use in each tab of the stock analysis widget? Also, can I use Analyst-Rating in the Fundamental tab?
evals.expected_output: A clear explanation of the four tabs (Overview, Fundamental, Technical, Sentiment) and which components are valid in each. Should explicitly state that Analyst-Rating is NOT valid in the Fundamental tab — it is only available in Sentiment.

assertions.name: explains-all-four-tabs
assertions.description: Response covers all four tabs: Overview, Fundamental, Technical, Sentiment

assertions.name: correctly-denies-analyst-rating-in-fundamental
assertions.description: Correctly states that Analyst-Rating is not available in the Fundamental tab

assertions.name: analyst-rating-only-in-sentiment
assertions.description: States Analyst-Rating is only valid in the Sentiment tab

assertions.name: overview-components-correct
assertions.description: States Overview supports only Investment-Rating and AI-Insights

evals.prompt: I'm building a React app and want to dynamically load the AInvest stock widget at runtime (not via script tags in HTML). Show me just the TSLA sentiment tab with investment ratings and analyst ratings. I don't have my API key yet.
evals.expected_output: JavaScript code using dynamic script loading (createElement/appendChild pattern) that loads scripts in order, then renders the Analysis component with TSLA configured for the Sentiment tab with Investment-Rating and Analyst-Rating components. Uses a placeholder API key string. Does NOT include Analysis-Checks in the Sentiment tab.

assertions.name: uses-dynamic-script-loading
assertions.description: Uses document.createElement('script') pattern or a loadScript helper, not static HTML script tags

assertions.name: loads-in-correct-order
assertions.description: React is loaded before ReactDOM, ReactDOM before widget

assertions.name: tsla-sentiment-tab-only
assertions.description: Only the Sentiment tab is configured for TSLA

assertions.name: correct-sentiment-components
assertions.description: Sentiment tab includes Investment-Rating and Analyst-Rating

assertions.name: no-analysis-checks-in-sentiment
assertions.description: Analysis-Checks does not appear in the Sentiment tab config

assertions.name: placeholder-api-key
assertions.description: Uses a clearly fake placeholder for the API key, not an invented real-looking key

evals.prompt: I just want to show AAPL sentiment — investment ratings and analyst ratings only. Give me a ready-to-run HTML file. My API key is 'sk-ainvest-demo-xyz'.
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML file that configures AAPL with only the Sentiment tab, containing Investment-Rating and Analyst-Rating components. No other tabs (Overview, Fundamental, Technical) should appear. Uses correct script load order, ReactDOM.createRoot, and the provided API key.

assertions.name: only-sentiment-tab
assertions.description: stockAnalysisItems config for AAPL contains exactly one tab: Sentiment

assertions.name: sentiment-has-investment-rating
assertions.description: Sentiment tab includes Investment-Rating component

assertions.name: sentiment-has-analyst-rating
assertions.description: Sentiment tab includes Analyst-Rating component

assertions.name: no-other-tabs
assertions.description: Output does not include Overview, Fundamental, or Technical tab labels

assertions.name: uses-provided-api-key
assertions.description: AINVEST_OPEN_API_KEY is set to the exact key the user provided, not a placeholder
